source_en: The last dispatch, Officer. The satchel feels heavier than it should.
Everything's green at the edges. The fog tells me to pull the wires down.
It speaks in my voice now. I can't tell which of us is talking.
Rest is where it gets in. If I stop walking, I stop being me.
There's a story in my satchel. The first thing I've finished in years.
The officer at the gate. Read it when I'm gone, not before.
A postman who forgot his own name. Not much of a plot.
If I come back wrong, Officer, remember the postman. Not the rest.
